authority_exclusions.root_not_exposed_semantics: local absence of a static root for that competition only; never endpoint unsupported, provider unavailable, upstream unavailable, or terminal

canonicalization.authority_sha256_basis: canonical minified UTF-8 JSON projection of the exact top-level fields listed in authority_sha256_fields
canonicalization.payload_sha256_basis: canonical minified UTF-8 JSON of the complete payload with payload_sha256 omitted after authority_sha256 is sealed
canonicalization.subdigest_basis: each named *_sha256 is canonical minified UTF-8 JSON of the exact sibling object or array named by that field; per-binding and per-static-chain digests omit only their own digest field

excluded_inputs: Git history as competition classification evidence
LeagueID.default or any implicit NBA fallback
future A1.2d source review, TaskPacket, implementation, tests, checked resource, receipt, and review
game, team, or player numeric/string ID shape, magnitude, or prefix
historical membership without an exact immutable request receipt
provider availability, response success, response emptiness, or terminal-state inference
unreviewed or superseded A1.2c implementation/output bytes
invalidation_triggers: Odds or ScoreBoard result-set path, field, raw-only projection, or source digest changes
a formerly implicit physical endpoint gains an explicit competition axis
any governing goal, facts, plan, traceability, J0F, or E1 input digest changes
any reviewed A1.2a, A1.2b, or final A1.2c authority, receipt, or review digest changes
any root parameter name/type/domain/requiredness or provider source contract changes
any static getter, source symbol, provider/data source, source-row, row-count, or fixed competition chain changes
competition values or their authority change
the independent source review reports any finding
the nba-api distribution version, RECORD authority, runtime/request/occurrence/applicability resource, or inner authority digest changes
the registered extractor alias inventory, any of the 13 repo source files, or any alias-to-provider binding changes

receipt_bound_root_policy.collision_policy: The same numeric or string game, team, or player ID may occur in multiple competitions. Resolution requires the exact league-bound receipt carried with the request unit; global ID uniqueness is never assumed.
digest_dependency_order: variant_evidence_sha256 over the complete typed variant evidence object
root_observation_sha256 over the exact root-observation projection including variant_evidence_sha256
receipt_sha256 over the complete ReceiptBoundCompetitionRootV1 object excluding only receipt_sha256

fixed_static_root_contract.static_chain_path: ImplicitCompetitionRootEvidenceV1.static_root_chains selected by exact dataset_id and fixed_league_id

game_root_requirements: exact league_id from the source request receipt
exact immutable source request and discovery generation digests
receipt_bound_root_policy.odds_rule: Each $.games.gameId row joins its own exact game receipt; no request-level NBA or single-competition assignment is permitted.
player_root_requirements: exact league_id from the source player-membership receipt
exact immutable source request and discovery generation digests
prohibited_inference_sources: NBA fallback or implicit NBA assumption
historical league membership without the request receipt
endpoint name alone for dynamic roots
receipt_bound_root_policy.receipt_sha256_basis: canonical minified UTF-8 JSON of the complete ReceiptBoundCompetitionRootV1 receipt with receipt_sha256 omitted
resolution_required_inputs: matching complete typed variant evidence object
exact root binding row identified by root_binding_sha256
matching producer/source receipt identified by source_request_receipt_sha256
receipt_bound_root_policy.root_observation_sha256_basis: canonical minified UTF-8 JSON of the exact root-observation projection named by root_observation_sha256_fields; root_observation_sha256 and receipt_sha256 are omitted and forbidden from that projection
receipt_bound_root_policy.scoreboard_rule: The raw $.scoreboard.leagueId must be a pinned competition value and every $.scoreboard.games.gameId row must join an exact game receipt carrying the same league_id; missing, ambiguous, mixed, or mismatched evidence is unresolved.

self_reference_rules.receipt_sha256: omitted only from the receipt_sha256 digest input
self_reference_rules.root_observation_sha256: omitted from the root_observation_sha256 projection and forbidden from typed variant evidence
self_reference_rules.variant_evidence_sha256: omitted from its own typed variant evidence digest input

static_root_requirements: exact provider source and embedded data source digests
team_root_requirements: exact league_id from the source team-membership receipt
exact immutable source request and discovery generation digests

typed_variant_contract.variant_evidence_sha256_basis: canonical minified UTF-8 JSON of exactly the common identity fields, common producer fields, and selected variant required fields; variant_evidence_sha256, root_observation_sha256, receipt_sha256, unknown fields, duplicate keys, non-finite values, and issued_at are forbidden

request_parameter.binding_rule: provider_occurrence_id, source_signature_sha256, and typed_domain_sha256 must equal the exact root_binding_sha256 row

retry_conditions: reread all immutable input hashes after a concurrent barrier change
rederive both complement methods after any registry, source, or checked-resource change
reseal only after the evidence and independent-review paths are absent and HEAD/origin/status are stable
stop_conditions: any denominator differs from 36 physical, 36 alias, 180 physical cells, 180 alias cells, 160 dynamic, 4 fixed static, 16 root_not_exposed, 30 parameter roots, or 13 source files
any implicit endpoint has an explicit competition axis
any dynamic root lacks an exact request/root binding or any static chain lacks complete pinned evidence
Odds or ScoreBoard raw/path evidence cannot be verified exactly
any cell promotes NBA default, ID shape, history, root_not_exposed, provider availability, upstream unavailable, or terminal status
any immutable input digest, branch/HEAD/origin edge, or finding-free A1.2c review precondition differs

static_root_chains.mapping_basis: exact provider helper and source-symbol identity joined to the pinned competition value; no LeagueID default is consulted
